name: power_terrain_passes
description: Test 27, by hand from 5 and 5.4 as answered for PW6. TerrainChanged with data1 = data2 = (21 << 16) | 25 -> rect x 20..25, z 20..25; one occupant-manager query over that rect. Pass 1, in list order: pole A = 271 (cell (22,22), inside, never inserted, so not in the simulator's pole list) gets BreakAllConnections(true) and RemoveOccupant; pole B = 272 is returned by the query (its query footprint covers the rect) but its own GetCell (40,40) is outside -> kept; building 277 does not answer the pole QI. Pass 2 collects the lines with two connected poles, distinct by pole pair in order: 273 (271, 272) is collected, 274 (271, 272) has the same pair and is skipped, 275 (272, 271) is a different ordered pair and is collected, 276 has no poles. Pass 3 asks each collected line for its poles again and calls first.RemoveConnection(second, 0): (271, 272) then (272, 271). The simulator's own lists do not change (the removals come back as 0x99EF1143).
